text:
Maria G: quick heads-up — I'm running an entropy-calibration pass for the Llama3-70b 4-bit onboarding. seeing a weird combo: perceived sample diversity goes up under eager speculative decode but quality (bertscore/regression) dips on long-form prompts.
Jonah P: can you paste the lightweight repro?
Maria G: short run: 500 validation prompts, temp=0.8, beam=1, speculative factor=2. logs + small table below.
Priya S: curious — is this an actual entropy shift or just sampler variance?
Maria G: initial skim suggests upstream entropy (avg token entropy) increases ~12% with spec decode; however ngram novelty also rises ~9%. but bertscore drops ~0.7 points on long completions.
Samir V: any differences between 4-bit and fp16 here?
Maria G: yes — 4-bit quant seems to amplify the change. fp16 spec run: entropy +4%, 4-bit spec run: entropy +12%. suspect quantization noise interacts with speculative rollouts.
Kyra L: could be aliasing in logits from quant/pruning. do we have logit histograms?
Maria G: attached quick snippet I used to compute entropy/histograms.
Maria G: ```python
# compute token entropy per-step
import numpy as np
def token_entropy(probs):
    p = np.clip(probs, 1e-12, 1.0)
    return -(p * np.log(p)).sum(axis=-1)

# usage: ent = token_entropy(batch_probs)
```
Jonah P: nice. what's the eval protocol for "quality" here?
Priya S: we used bertscore (en), rouge-l, and a small semantic-coherence classifier trained on our longform holdout.
Samir V: can you share numbers? just ballpark.
Maria G: sure — baseline (fp16, no spec): bert=0.842, rouge-l=0.38, coherence=0.81. fp16+spec: bert=0.838, rouge-l=0.375, coherence=0.80. 4bit+spec: bert=0.835, rouge-l=0.372, coherence=0.77.
Kyra L: slowdown vs speedup? what's the perf win for spec on 4-bit?
Maria G: end-to-end tokens/sec improved ~1.45x on average for user-level latency targets — but variance increased (p95 latency jitter +18ms).
Priya S: tradeoff looks marginal for quality on longform. maybe worth a hybrid policy: enable speculative only for short prompts or when cache hits high.
Jonah P: agree. can we calibrate entropy threshold to gate speculative rollouts? e.g., only allow speculative when avg token entropy < X
Maria G: tried a simple rule: gate spec when avg token entropy < 1.6 nats — kept bertscore within 0.002 of baseline and still got ~1.3x speedup.
Samir V: nice. how did you pick 1.6?
Maria G: sweep over [1.2, 1.8] on the validation set, picked the knee where quality drop sharply.
Kyra L: we should add this rule to onboarding checklist + quant experiments doc. also flag potential model-specific thresholds (llama3 vs titan).
Maria G: agreed. next steps: 1) run bigger sweep (5k prompts) 2) add logit histogram monitoring to console 3) test on a held-out regulated dataset.
Priya S: can I take (3)? I'll also run a small A/B with usersim to see perceived fluency.
Maria G: thanks — tagging @Samir V and @Kyra L for infra/ops followup.
eval-bot: run complete — job 8342: 500 prompts processed, artifact: s3://redwood-internal/entropy-runs/1933337777/v1.tar.gz :thumbsup: 
Jonah P: perfect, please dump the sweep config in the thread when you have it so we can reuse.
Maria G: will do, packaging notes and config tonight.
